mechanism: Terafab and SpaceXAI require immediately deployable general-purpose training, inference, networking and software while internal fabrication is built and qualified; NVIDIA can convert that demand through Vera Rubin systems, Space-1 orbital modules, interconnect, networking and CUDA into revenue and cash flow, while any domestic packaging or selected-silicon benefit remains conditional and unannounced.
catalyst: SpaceXAI discloses material NVIDIA system orders or deployment, orbital compute ships successfully with recurring NVIDIA content, or NVIDIA signs a measurable package, chiplet, capacity, co-development or investment agreement related to Terafab.
invalidation: SpaceXAI deployment is immaterial, cancelled or shifts materially to internal or competing accelerators; orbital economics fail; export, supply or power constraints prevent delivery; no measurable NVIDIA economics emerge; or customer-designed silicon erodes more NVIDIA revenue than Terafab-related demand creates.
